messages.body_plain:
On 09/02/2009 11:11 PM, Yury Bukhman wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> we have organized a new R user group in Madison, WI, USA.  I have edited the rugs:r_user_groups page to put in information about our group.  I would like to create a Wiki page for our meeting schedule, and possibly other related pages in the future.  Would it be appropriate to use the R Wiki for that?  If so, where in the name spaces should I put my page(s)?
>
> Thanks.
>
> Yury

Sure. Put it wherever common sense drives you ... for example 
rugs:r_user_groups:madison

Romain
